chunks: The day when man remembers all that he had done,
ai.seo_question: What happens to a person's memory of their deeds on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Fajr highlights the moment of intense self-realization where individuals confront the cumulative weight of their worldly efforts, underscoring the principle of individual accountability (hisab) distinct from communal intercession. It serves as a poignant reminder that one's ultimate fate is determined by the sincerity and quality of their own 'sae' (effort/striving), a concept deeply linked to the Shia understanding of divine justice (Adl).
